blind.description: A classic wooden executive desk featuring a dark green leather-inlaid tabletop with gold corner filigree detailing. The desk structure consists of two pedestal drawer units flanking a central kneehole space. The front displays seven drawers with curved brass drop handles (three on each side pedestal and one wide, shallow central drawer), while the rear features matching wooden paneling. The model is clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted or PBR wood textures, sitting flat on the floor with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular wooden desktop with molded trim around a dark green rectangular blotter inlay that has decorative gold border corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 ft tall), and approximately 5 ft wide.
